name: Debt Payoff Planner API
shortDescription: Deterministic avalanche vs snowball debt payoff — months to debt-free, total interest, and interest saved vs minimums
description: Agent-native debt-payoff intelligence computed in real month-by-month simulation (not by a language model). /plan simulates both the avalanche (highest-APR first) and snowball (smallest-balance first) strategies with real APR/12 interest accrual and minimum-payment rollover, then returns each strategy's months-to-debt-free, total interest, total paid, and per-debt payoff order — plus a recommended strategy and the interest and months saved versus paying only minimums. The one-call /lookup adds assumptions, an extra-payment sensitivity table (+0/+50/+100/+200), a reasoning object (why_result_generated, key_factors, invalidators), and prioritized actions. Honestly flags debts whose payments never cover interest. Every response carries a financial_disclaimer; results are deterministic so confidence is always 1.0.

name: Retirement Planner API
shortDescription: Deterministic retirement projection — nominal & inflation-adjusted balance, 4%-rule sustainable income, and nest-egg gap
description: Agent-native retirement intelligence computed in real future-value math (not by a language model). /project compounds current savings + monthly contributions to the retirement date and returns the projected balance in both nominal and inflation-adjusted (today's) dollars, total contributions, investment growth, the 4%-rule sustainable annual income, and — when a target income is supplied — the nest-egg target, surplus/gap, income-replacement ratio, and an on_track verdict. The one-call /lookup adds the monthly contribution required to close any gap, explicit assumptions, a return-rate sensitivity table (± 2%), a reasoning object (why_result_generated, key_factors, invalidators), and prioritized actions. Every response carries a financial_disclaimer; results are deterministic so confidence is always 1.0.

name: Savings Goal Optimizer API
shortDescription: Deterministic savings-goal planner — time-to-goal, required monthly contribution, or projected balance with compound interest
description: Agent-native savings-goal intelligence computed in real monthly compound-interest math (not by a language model). Given a goal and current savings, /calculate runs one of three modes automatically: supply a monthly contribution to get the time-to-goal, supply a target date to get the required monthly contribution, or supply both to get the projected balance plus surplus/shortfall. Returns amount remaining, months-to-goal, required contribution, total contributions, and investment growth as applicable. The one-call /lookup adds explicit assumptions, a sensitivity table on the operative lever, a reasoning object (why_result_generated, key_factors, invalidators), and prioritized actions. Every response carries a financial_disclaimer; results are deterministic so confidence is always 1.0.

name: Budget Planner API
shortDescription: Deterministic 50/30/20 budget analyzer — needs/wants/savings buckets, savings rate, per-bucket variance, and overspending
description: Agent-native budget intelligence computed in pure arithmetic (not by a language model). /analyze buckets monthly spending into needs/wants/savings (from an itemized expense list or direct totals), compares the allocation to the 50/30/20 rule, and returns each bucket's amount and percent of income, the recommended targets, per-bucket variance, the savings rate, a status (overspending/balanced/surplus), unallocated dollars, and an optional per-category breakdown. The one-call /lookup adds explicit assumptions, a reasoning object (why_result_generated, key_factors, invalidators), and prioritized recommendations. Every response carries a financial_disclaimer; results are deterministic so confidence is always 1.0.

name: Net Worth Tracker API
shortDescription: Deterministic net-worth calculator — assets minus liabilities, debt-to-asset ratio, liquidity, and wealth benchmark
description: Agent-native net-worth intelligence computed in pure arithmetic (not by a language model). /calculate sums assets and liabilities, computes net worth and the debt-to-asset ratio, identifies liquid assets, breaks down each side by type with percentages, flags solvency, and — when age and income are supplied — benchmarks against the age×income/10 wealth target with a prosperity tier (under/average/prodigious accumulator). The one-call /lookup adds explicit assumptions, a reasoning object (why_result_generated, key_factors, invalidators), and prioritized actions. Every response carries a financial_disclaimer; results are deterministic so confidence is always 1.0.
